# Rebel Talent Systems

> Rebel Talent Systems recruits for startups and defense contractors. Contingent search, an embedded desk, and cleared searches that include TS/SCI with a full scope poly.

Richie Lampani is the founder. The firm is in Roswell, Georgia. (202) 524-0255. richie@rebeltalentsystems.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rebeltalentsystems.com/): Contingent search or an embedded desk, for Series A through C and defense teams.
- [TS/SCI full scope poly recruiting for defense contractors](https://rebeltalentsystems.com/cleared): How full scope poly candidates are sourced, how a cleared search differs from a commercial one, and how to unstick a stalled cleared req.
- [Fractional recruiter for Series A startups](https://rebeltalentsystems.com/fractional-recruiter-for-series-a): An embedded recruiter for the stretch when the hiring plan is bigger than the founders.
- [Contingent tech recruiting for startups](https://rebeltalentsystems.com/contingent-tech-recruiting): One technical role, or a few, when the seat is already defined.
- [Hire a technical product manager](https://rebeltalentsystems.com/hire-a-tpm): A TPM search scoped to the product and the engineers. No day count is published on the page.
- [Open roles](https://rebeltalentsystems.com/jobs): Roles the firm is running, including cleared seats and a technical product manager listing when one is open.
- [How we engage](https://rebeltalentsystems.com/services): Contingent, retained, embedded, and advisory.
- [Fractional desk](https://rebeltalentsystems.com/fractional): The embedded recruiting offer.
- [Contingent search](https://rebeltalentsystems.com/contingent): The one-role search.
- [About](https://rebeltalentsystems.com/about): The firm.
